title: DeepMind publishes SynthID Bio in Nature to watermark AI-designed proteins
summary: Google DeepMind published methods to embed verifiable watermarks in AI-designed protein sequences and structures without impairing function, aimed at biosecurity provenance.

title: California bars AI-only firings as Newsom signs SB 947
summary: California became the first US state to bar employers from relying solely on automated systems to fire or discipline workers, requiring human corroboration and notice.
